title: The Bird That Stays in the Air for 10 Months Straight

scenes.text: One bird stays in the air for ten months.
It's the common swift, and scientists tracked it with tiny data loggers.
When it isn't breeding, some of them never touch down once.
Over 99 percent of the time, the loggers showed them airborne.
Scientists estimate a lifetime of flying equals about seven round trips to the Moon.
And how does it sleep up there? Scientists still aren't sure.

description:
One bird stays in the air for ten months.
Common swifts tracked with tiny data loggers spent more than 99 percent of their non-breeding season airborne. Researchers still can't say for sure how they sleep.
Could you go ten months without landing? Tell us below.
first_comment: Swifts can live up to 20 years. Where do you think they sleep?
